proposal.summary: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in General Solutions Steiner GmbH CASE 3 Taskmanagement V 3.3 allows attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload injected into the fieldname parameter.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue against CASE 3 Taskmanagement v3.3, capturing the exact request and payload to the fieldname parameter. Determine whether authentication is required and whether the payload is reflected or stored. If confirmed, recommend validating/escaping input on the server side and applying output encoding on affected pages; prepare a patch and coordinated disclosure timeline.
